purpose: Replace only the installed Weather privileged broker plus registration with the reviewed v10 successor transport, accepting either the historical v9 broker or an already-installed reviewed v10 successor broker as predecessor only when the root-owned registration broker hash matches exactly one fixed Git source at the registered predecessor commit.
preflight_requires: source checkout is clean and reviewed-origin
registration is exact root-owned 0600 and provides the runtime predecessor source SHA and broker SHA-256
registered broker SHA-256 matches exactly one existing executable Git blob from the fixed historical-v9/v10-successor broker source allowlist at the registered predecessor source
runtime predecessor source descends from the reviewed v9 capability floor and is an ancestor of target source
installed module/broker/socket/service hashes exactly match the selected predecessor identity
target module/socket/service remain byte-identical to the installed predecessor source
target successor broker is executable in Git and differs from predecessor broker
durable replay/state DB exists with exact root-owned 0600 metadata
later_gate_order: fresh root-capable read-only live preflight resolving the installed predecessor from registration
separate owner LIVE broker+registration refresh bound to exact reviewed main SHA
post-refresh broker/registration identity and replay-state preservation verification
fresh READY queue and direct-owner v10 LIVE-AUTH
fresh Weather baseline/JIT reconciliation before application rollout
explicit_exclusions: no predecessor broker source outside the fixed historical-v9/v10-successor allowlist
no generic sudo/root shell or caller-selected command/path/argv/environment
no READY queue or LIVE-AUTH creation by this refresh operator
